questions.question: The Motorcycle Safety Foundation recommends the SEE strategy for safe riding. What does SEE stand for?
questions.correctAnswerText: Search, Evaluate, and Execute
questions.explanation: SEE stands for Search, Evaluate, and Execute. Good riders use this strategy to make safe decisions while riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or lettering. This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Only ride in the left portion of the lane.
Change your lane position based on road and traffic conditions.
Only ride in the right portion of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your lane position based on road and traffic conditions.
questions.explanation: No single lane position is always best. Move around in your lane based on what the road and traffic conditions require.

questions.question: The best footwear for motorcycle riders is:
questions.correctAnswerText: Sturdy boots
questions.explanation: Leather boots give the best foot protection. Choose boots that are high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: A pre-ride inspection should include all of the following, except:
questions.correctAnswerText: Inspecting the paint
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tires, controls, lights, signals, mirrors, brakes, oil, fluids, chassis, and stands. Paint inspection is not necessary.

questions.question: When entering a turn, you should:

options.text: Take the motorcycle out of gear

questions.correctAnswerText: Change gears before the turn
questions.explanation: Change gears before you enter a turn. If you must change gears while turning, do it smoothly.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, your lane position:

options.text: Makes little difference in whether other drivers can see you
Is important because it affects whether other drivers can see you
Cannot protect you from wind blasts from other vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: Is important because it affects whether other drivers can see you
questions.explanation: The right lane position helps you see better and be seen better. Good positioning also protects you from wind blasts from other vehicles.

questions.question: Which lane position allows a car ahead to see you in their rearview mirror?

options.text: The left portion of the lane
The center portion of the lane
The right portion of the lane
No lane position allows you to be seen

questions.correctAnswerText: The center portion of the lane
questions.explanation: Riding in the center of your lane usually puts your image in the rearview mirror of the car ahead. Drivers check their rearview mirrors more often than side mirrors, so they are more likely to see you.

questions.question: When riding in a group, riders should:

options.text: Maintain safe distance from each other
Follow each other as closely as possible
Not worry about the distance between riders

questions.correctAnswerText: Maintain safe distance from each other
questions.explanation: When riding as a group, use a staggered formation. This keeps the group together while maintaining safe distances between riders.

questions.question: Which material provides the best crash protection?
questions.correctAnswerText: Leather or synthetic materials
questions.explanation: Leather and synthetic materials offer the best protection in a crash. Always wear long pants and a jacket while riding.

questions.question: Use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection to:

options.text: Check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
Look for dark clouds that may indicate bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors to see if drivers behind you are paying attention to you. Use mirrors when stopping to make sure approaching drivers are reacting to your stop.

questions.question: Which color makes you less visible to other drivers?
questions.correctAnswerText: Brown
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors like orange, red, yellow, or green to stay visible. Avoid dark or dull colors when riding.

questions.question: Keeping space between you and other vehicles helps because:

options.text: You can draft off other vehicles better.
You have more time to react to other drivers' movements.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have more time to react to other drivers' movements.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your motorcycle at all times. This gives you more time to respond to hazards and more room to move safely.

questions.question: Riding boots or shoes should:

options.text: Be made of soft, flexible material.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover the ankles.
questions.explanation: Choose sturdy boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. The soles should be hard, durable, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: Unlike other drinks, alcohol:

options.text: Is absorbed into the bloodstream right away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is absorbed into the bloodstream right away.
questions.explanation: Alcohol does not need to be digested. It is absorbed directly through the stomach and small intestine, enters the blood, and quickly reaches the brain.

questions.question: Improper braking:

options.text: Is a major cause of motorcycle crashes.
Should not be a concern because motorcycles have two brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is a major cause of motorcycle crashes.
questions.explanation: Improper braking causes many motorcycle crashes. Using correct braking technique is important for safe riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Merge
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black symbols warn drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic is merging ahead.

questions.question: To avoid a collision, a motorcyclist should:

options.text: Never move to avoid a hazard.
Look 10 to 15 seconds ahead on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look 10 to 15 seconds ahead on the road.
questions.explanation: Look ahead 10 to 15 seconds on the road to spot hazards early. This gives you time to react before you reach the hazard.

questions.question: As your motorcycle speeds up, you will:
questions.correctAnswerText: Shift up to higher gears.
questions.explanation: As speed increases, shift into higher gears.

questions.question: Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS) are designed to:

options.text: Stop wheels from locking up and skidding.
Lock the wheels but still allow control.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop wheels from locking up and skidding.
questions.explanation: ABS prevents skidding and wheel lock-up during hard braking. When sensors detect possible wheel lock, brake pressure is released and re-applied to keep braking effective.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road will be slippery when wet.

questions.question: When choosing a protective jacket for riding a motorcycle, you should look for one that is:

options.text: Made of leather or synthetic materials.

questions.correctAnswerText: Made of leather or synthetic materials.
questions.explanation: Wear protective gear when riding. Choose a jacket that covers your arms fully and fits snugly. It should still let you move freely. Leather or strong synthetic materials with body armor offer the best protection.

questions.question: When alcohol and drugs are used together, the effects are:

options.text: Less dangerous than when either is used alone.
Stronger than when either is used alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stronger than when either is used alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, make riding unsafe. When drugs are mixed with alcohol, the danger increases even more.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop completely. Wait for a signal that allows you to turn in the direction you want to go.

questions.question: If riding during the day, you should wear:

options.text: Brightly-colored clothing to increase your chances of being seen.
Clothing of any color because other drivers can easily see you in daylight.
Darkly-colored clothing to contrast with the bright sunlight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brightly-colored clothing to increase your chances of being seen.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. Always wear bright colors to be more visible to other drivers, even during the day.
